name: ignition
description: Ignition proposal and client management via Ignition's hosted OAuth MCP server. 78 tools across 16 groups — agreed services, billing items, clients & contacts, deals, discovery, email templates, forms, invoices, message templates, payments, practice, proposals, services, tax rates, terms templates, and users. Browser OAuth, no API keys.

connection.instructions: Enter https://mcp.ignitionapp.com/mcp as the MCP server URL in your AI app. You will be redirected to Ignition to sign in and approve access. No API keys or tokens are required.
